sources.title: Notice of Funding Availability—Covered Technology Categories—Equipment Financing
sources.publisher: Federal Register / Office of Strategic Capital
retrieved_facts: The inaugural equipment-finance NOFA made up to 984 million dollars of aggregate direct-loan funding available.
The notice defines the application process and broad statutory, national-security, additionality, and creditworthiness considerations.
The notice does not publish the later applicant, selected, rejected, negotiated-term, disbursement, performance, or recovery denominator.

sources.title: OSC Receives $8.9 Billion in Financing Requests for First Domestic Manufacturing Loan Program
retrieved_facts: OSC reported more than 200 applications from 38 states.
Applicants requested 8.9 billion dollars against 984 million dollars of initial lending capacity.
Individual requests ranged from 10 million to 150 million dollars.
OSC expected to approve financing for a selected subset, but applicant identities and dispositions were not published.

sources.title: OSC Announces First Loan Through DoD Agreement With MP Materials
retrieved_facts: OSC described a 150 million dollar direct loan to MP Materials as its first executed direct loan.
An executed loan is not evidence of full disbursement, performance, repayment, or public recovery.

sources.title: OSC Agrees to Joint $700M Conditional Loan Commitment with Vulcan Elements and ReElement Technologies
retrieved_facts: OSC announced separate conditional commitments of 620 million dollars to Vulcan Elements and 80 million dollars to ReElement Technologies.
Conditional commitments are not executed loans or disbursements.

sources.title: OSC Signs $500 Million Conditional Loan Commitment With Phoenix Tailings
retrieved_facts: OSC announced a 500 million dollar conditional loan commitment with Phoenix Tailings.
The announcement does not establish closing, draw, performance, repayment, or public recovery.

sources.title: OSC Signs $725 Million Conditional Loan Commitment With Energy Fuels
retrieved_facts: OSC announced a 725 million dollar conditional loan commitment with Energy Fuels.
The announcement does not establish closing, draw, performance, repayment, or public recovery.
